source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of commonly used algorithms (PDF 83).

blocks.text: Algorithms computer science ke zaroori tools (auzaar) hain aur bohat se maslon par lagte hain, data sort karne se le kar bare datasets mein maloomat dhoondne tak. Kuch algorithms basic hain aur zyada complex (mushkil) kaamon ke building blocks (eentein) bante hain. Is hisse mein sab se zyada istemal hone wale kuch algorithms dekhe jayenge: sorting, searching aur graph traversal (graph ke nodes se guzarna) algorithms.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke algorithms ke teen families (groups) bataiye.

items: Aam algorithms: sorting, searching, graph traversal.
